title: Planeward app manifest
description: planeward.json: how `planeward dev` runs and emulates a Planeward app.

name.description: Display name shown in the emulator host.

slug.description: Lowercase slug; the local app id is `<slug>-local`.

experiencePath.description: Path on dev.url rendered in the Experience view (members, inside the app's community channel).

dashboardPath.description: Path on dev.url rendered in the Dashboard view (workspace staff).

webhookPath.description: Path on dev.url that receives signed webhooks.

scopes.description: Scopes the emulator grants the app.

command.description: Shell command that starts the app, e.g. `next dev --port 3005`.

url.description: Origin the app serves on, e.g. `http://localhost:3005`.

plans.description: Fake membership plans. The emulator can simulate a member on each one, and dev.grants.plans grants community permissions to them.

grants.description: Permission grants for the app's /.well-known/planeward-permissions keys. The emulator's Permissions panel writes this. Community keys resolve like production: the declared default, then everyone, then the member's plans (any "on" beats "off"). Dashboard keys are true or false for the simulated staff role, else the declared default.

everyone.description: Community keys for @everyone (every member): "on" or "off"; a key left out is Unset.

additionalProperties.description: Community permission keys mapped to "on" or "off"; a key left out is Unset.

dashboard.description: Dashboard keys mapped to true (on) or false (off); a key left out uses the declared default.
